description: Use this when an owner wants booking and ask notices for a place sent somewhere else, for example "text my bookings to my phone". send_to is an email, or a phone that gets them as texts; one at a time, as in the console. An empty send_to sends them to the account's own phone or email. Read it back to the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. The phone is never shown on the place's page. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the place.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to where booking notices go.

place_id.description: The place_id of one of the owner's places, from get_gym_report or create_or_claim_place.

send_to.description: An email, or a phone with its country code for texts, for example +15125550100. "" for the account's own.

name: set_booking_notices

place.description: The place: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, address, hours, about, book_url, request_email, request_phone (texts, never public), prices, phone, timezone, status (draft or live), page_url, upcoming_classes, brain_id, on_plan, held_requests and plan_url (the plan on phor.me, a price-free link; null when on the plan).

title: Set where booking notices go
